title: Veyra E2E screenshot sidecar metadata
description: Written beside every captured PNG as <name>.json. Machine evidence; the PNG is visual evidence.

changed_pct_vs_previous.description: Changed-pixel fraction vs the previous capture in this test (null for the first).

expected_spatial_mode.description: Runner-derived expectation (start mode XOR parity of spatial toggles it injected). Never a compositor observation.

expected_workspace.description: Runner-derived expectation from the workspace-switch chords it injected.

focused_window.description: Runner-derived expectation from its own focus actions, when known.
